description: This file defines the UpdateDatasetCommand class, which handles updating dataset metadata, validation, and permission checks within the Superset project. It includes methods for validating dataset source, semantics, columns, metrics, and folder structure, as well as executing the update with transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateDatasetCommand
classes.description: A command class for updating dataset metadata, performing validation, permission checks, and executing the update within a transaction.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the command with dataset ID, data, and override options.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs validation and updates the dataset within a transaction, returning the updated model.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates dataset existence, ownership, source, and semantics before update.

methods.name: _validate_dataset_source
methods.description: Validates and sets the dataset's database, catalog, and table information.

methods.name: _validate_sql_access
methods.description: Checks SQL query access permissions and validity.

methods.name: _validate_semantics
methods.description: Validates columns, metrics, and folder structure for correctness and consistency.

methods.name: _validate_columns
methods.description: Validates columns for duplicates, existence, and name uniqueness.

methods.name: _validate_metrics
methods.description: Validates metrics for duplicates, existence, and name uniqueness.
